prepSteps.title: Launch CloudFormation from the Entro wizard
prepSteps.instruction: In Entro, open Add New Account → AWS, choose CloudFormation, and launch the stack from that wizard. Stay in the Entro UI until the stack finishes and the account shows Active. Do not create the stack from the AWS CLI.
prepSteps.evidence: Integrations → AWS lists the account as Active

operatorOnly.reason: Entro launches the CloudFormation stack from the Add New Account wizard; there is no CLI create-stack step on this path
operatorOnly.evidence: Integrations → AWS lists the account as Active

prepSteps.title: Create the read-only IAM policy and role
prepSteps.instruction: In IAM, create Entro's read-only policy, create a role trusted by Entro's AWS account with the wizard External ID, and attach the policy.
prepSteps.evidence: IAM shows the Entro role with the read-only policy and a matching trust policy

prepSteps.title: Copy the Role ARN
prepSteps.instruction: Open the role and copy its ARN for the Entro form.
prepSteps.evidence: The Role ARN is recorded in the operator vault (not in chat)

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Create the read-only IAM policy and role
typedActions.preview: aws iam get-role --role-name <role_name> (inspect collision); no create dry-run
typedActions.mutation: aws iam create-policy then aws iam create-role with Entro account trust and ExternalId condition, then aws iam attach-role-policy
typedActions.expectedChange: IAM shows the Entro role with the read-only policy and matching trust policy
typedActions.verification: aws iam get-role --role-name <role_name> ; aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name <role_name>
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Detach policy, delete role, delete policy version if this run created them

typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: aws iam get-role --role-name <role_name> --query Role.Arn --output text (record in operator vault, not chat)
typedActions.expectedChange: Role ARN recorded for the Entro form
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: No mutation; stop has no residual change

prepSteps.title: Initialize the Entro Terraform module
prepSteps.instruction: Copy Terraform-Entro.tf into the workspace and run terraform init.
prepSteps.evidence: terraform init completes and providers are installed

prepSteps.title: Plan and apply the Entro IAM roles
prepSteps.instruction: Set external_id, remote_agent, and optional sns_topic_arn_suffix, then terraform apply so member accounts get EntroAWSIntegrationRole.
prepSteps.evidence: EntroAWSIntegrationRole and EntroReadOnlyAccess exist in member accounts

prepSteps.title: Copy the Role ARN
prepSteps.instruction: Copy EntroAWSIntegrationRole ARN from a member account for the Entro form.
prepSteps.evidence: The Role ARN is recorded in the operator vault (not in chat)

typedActions.mutation: terraform init in <terraform_dir> after copying Entro's Terraform-Entro.tf module into that workspace
typedActions.target: Operator Terraform workspace for AWS Organizations
typedActions.expectedChange: terraform init completes and providers are installed
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Remove .terraform/ created this run if stopping before apply

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Plan and apply the Entro IAM roles
typedActions.mutation: terraform apply -var external_id=<external_id> -var remote_agent=<remote_agent> -var sns_topic_arn_suffix=<sns_topic_arn_suffix> after Approve
typedActions.expectedChange: EntroAWSIntegrationRole and EntroReadOnlyAccess exist in member accounts
typedActions.verification: terraform show ; aws iam get-role --role-name EntroAWSIntegrationRole
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: terraform destroy of this workspace's state after Approve if rolling back this run

typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: aws iam get-role --role-name EntroAWSIntegrationRole --query Role.Arn --output text (record in operator vault, not chat)
typedActions.expectedChange: Role ARN recorded for the Entro form
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: No mutation; stop has no residual change
